New leader aims to carry on legacy at Jefferson County Community and Senior Center
By Central Oregon Daily News Staff,
1 hours agoMADRAS, Ore. -- The Jefferson County Community and Senior Center is welcoming new leadership. Krista Acevedo is settling into her new role as the senior center's first official director. Acevedo hopes to continue the legacy of Louise Muir, who ran operations without the official job title before passing away last year.
